name: Redis for Developers and Operators
tools: Client libraries for Python, Node.js and Java

beginner.summary: For developers and DBAs starting with Redis. Covers installing Redis and Redis Insight, strings and expiry, lists and queues, hashes, sets and sorted sets, key design, caching patterns, transactions and WATCH, Lua scripts and functions, pub/sub, streams, RDB and AOF persistence, memory and eviction, ACLs and TLS, clients for Python, Node.js and Java, rate limiting and counters, sessions and leaderboards, monitoring and running Redis in Docker or as a managed service.
prerequisites: Writes code in Python, Node.js or Java
outcomes: Use Redis data types to solve common application problems
Apply caching, rate limiting, queue and leaderboard patterns
Configure persistence, memory limits and security
Monitor Redis and run it locally or as a managed service

days.topic: Redis Overview, Installation and Tooling Setup
subtopics: What Redis is: an in-memory data structure server
Common uses: caching, sessions, queues and real-time features
Installing Redis with Docker or a package manager
Latency numbers that make Redis fast
The course project: a caching and leaderboard service
days.lab_task: Run Redis in Docker, connect with redis-cli and Redis Insight, set and read keys, measure command latency and sketch how the course project will use Redis.
Store page view counters and short-lived tokens, set expiry correctly, use SET NX for one-time actions and scan keys safely instead of using KEYS.
checks: SCAN returns keys without blocking the server

subtopics: When lists are the wrong choice
days.lab_task: Build a simple job queue with blocking pops, a reliable variant that moves jobs to a processing list, and a capped recent activity feed.
checks: Worker receives jobs as they are pushed
Job left in processing is recovered after a crash
objectives: Use lists for queues and feeds

days.lab_task: Model user profiles and product details as hashes, update single fields, keep per-field counters and compare memory use with storing JSON strings.
checks: Single field changed without rewriting the object
Memory use compared for hashes and strings

subtopics: Set operations: union, intersection and difference
Choosing between sets and sorted sets
days.lab_task: Track unique visitors with sets, find common interests with intersections, build a game leaderboard with sorted sets and a recent-items index scored by time.
checks: Leaderboard returns the top ten in order
Common interests found between two users
Items older than a day removed by score

subtopics: Key naming with prefixes and separators
Including IDs and versions in keys
days.lab_task: Design the keyspace for the course project with naming rules, versions, expiry per key type and size limits, and find big keys in a sample dataset.
checks: Every key type follows the naming rules
Each key type has an expiry policy

days.lab_task: Add cache-aside caching in front of a slow database query, invalidate on updates, choose TTLs and measure latency and hit rate under load.
checks: Cached reads much faster than database reads
Hit rate reported from INFO stats

days.topic: Transactions with MULTI and Optimistic Locking with WATCH
days.lab_task: Transfer points between two users atomically, protect a stock count with WATCH and retries under concurrent updates, and compare with an atomic command approach.
checks: Balances always add up after transfers
Atomic command and WATCH versions compared

days.lab_task: Write a Lua script that reserves stock only if enough is available, convert it to a Redis Function library and measure the effect of a slow script.
checks: Reservation never goes below zero under load
Slow script blocks other clients as expected

days.lab_task: Broadcast cache invalidation messages to three app instances with pub/sub, show what happens to messages when a subscriber is offline and compare with streams.
checks: All instances clear the cache entry

days.lab_task: Build an order events stream with a consumer group of two workers, acknowledge processed entries, reclaim entries from a crashed worker and trim the stream.
checks: Crashed worker's entries claimed and processed
Stream kept to the configured length

subtopics: Why persistence matters for an in-memory store
Choosing settings for your use case
days.lab_task: Configure RDB and AOF, write data, kill Redis without warning and compare what each setting recovers, then back up and restore from a snapshot.
checks: Data recovered according to the fsync policy
Snapshot restored on a new instance
Settings chosen and justified for two use cases

subtopics: Eviction policies: LRU, LFU, volatile and allkeys
days.lab_task: Set a memory limit, fill Redis past it under different eviction policies, observe which keys go, read memory reports and size memory for the course project.
checks: Memory estimate for the project with headroom

subtopics: Why Redis must not be exposed openly
days.lab_task: Lock down Redis with ACL users per application, limit commands and key patterns, enable TLS and show rejected commands in the ACL log.
checks: App user cannot run FLUSHALL or read other prefixes

days.topic: Using Redis from Python, Node.js and Java
days.lab_task: Build the same caching module in two languages with connection pools, pipelining, timeouts and retries, and test both against a Redis container.
checks: Pipelined writes faster than single commands
Tests pass against a Redis container

subtopics: Sliding window logs with sorted sets
days.lab_task: Build fixed window and sliding window rate limiters for an API, compare accuracy and cost, and test them under concurrent load.
checks: Sliding window avoids the boundary burst

days.lab_task: Store sessions for a web app in Redis with sliding expiry and logout everywhere, and build daily and all-time leaderboards with rank and neighbour queries.
checks: All sessions for a user removed
Players above and below a user returned
Daily leaderboard resets while all-time stays

days.topic: Monitoring with INFO, SLOWLOG and Redis Insight
days.lab_task: Generate load with a slow command, find it in SLOWLOG and latency reports, analyse memory in Redis Insight and write a list of alerts for production.
checks: Largest key patterns found in Redis Insight

days.topic: Running Redis in Docker and Managed Services
subtopics: Redis in Docker and Docker Compose
Managed services: ElastiCache, Azure Managed Redis and Redis Cloud
tools: Amazon ElastiCache or Azure Managed Redis
days.lab_task: Run Redis with persistence in Docker Compose for development, connect the app to a managed Redis service with TLS and compare cost and features.
days.deliverable: Local and managed setups with a comparison
checks: Redis keeps data across container restarts
App connects to the managed service over TLS

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Caching and Leaderboard Service
days.lab_task: Build a service that caches product data, rate-limits API calls, stores sessions, processes events from a stream and serves live leaderboards, with persistence, security and monitoring, then demo it.
days.deliverable: Repository, running service and demo recording
checks: Caching, limits, sessions, events and leaderboards work
Tests pass against a Redis container
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one service

intermediate.summary: For developers and operators running Redis in production. Covers replication, Sentinel, Redis Cluster and hash slots, client-side caching, stampedes and hot keys, streams with consumer groups, distributed locks, job queues on Redis, the query engine, JSON, vector search, time series and probabilistic structures, pipelining and big keys, production persistence and backups, Redis on Kubernetes, managed Redis, Valkey and licensing choices, hardening and observability.
prerequisites: Has used Redis data types in an application
Comfortable with caching patterns and Redis persistence
outcomes: Run highly available and clustered Redis
Build reliable queues, locks, search and vector features on Redis
Operate Redis securely on Kubernetes or managed services

days.lab_task: Set up a primary with two replicas, read from replicas, measure replica lag under load, use WAIT for an important write and show data loss risk on failover.
checks: Replica lag measured under heavy writes
Write acknowledged by a replica before success

days.lab_task: Deploy three Sentinels with a primary and two replicas, kill the primary under load, measure failover time and confirm clients reconnect automatically.
checks: Clients reconnect to the new primary

days.topic: Redis Cluster: Sharding and Hash Slots
days.lab_task: Create a six-node cluster, spread keys across slots, use hash tags for multi-key operations, reshard under load and fail a primary.
checks: Multi-key operation works across tagged keys
Slots moved with no client errors

days.lab_task: Enable client-side caching for hot configuration keys, show invalidation when values change and measure the latency and load saved.
checks: Client cache updated when the value changes
Local reads faster than Redis reads

days.topic: Advanced Caching: Stampedes, Hot Keys and Invalidation
subtopics: Hot keys and replication of hot data
days.lab_task: Reproduce a stampede and a hot key under load, fix the stampede with early refresh and locks, spread the hot key and add tag-based invalidation.
checks: One rebuild per expiry under load
All entries for a product cleared together

days.topic: Streams in Depth: Consumer Groups and Exactly-Once Patterns
days.lab_task: Build an event processor with consumer groups, automatic claiming of stuck entries, dead letter handling after retries and idempotent processing, and monitor lag.
checks: Entries from a dead consumer reclaimed
Entries moved aside after three failures
Duplicate deliveries have no extra effect

days.lab_task: Build a lock with safe release and renewal, show a failure where a paused process loses its lock, protect writes with fencing tokens and discuss Redlock.
checks: Only the owner can release the lock
Paused process writes after losing its lock
Fencing tokens block the stale write

days.topic: Redis as a Job Queue: BullMQ, Sidekiq and Celery
subtopics: Job queue libraries built on Redis
days.lab_task: Run a background job system on Redis with BullMQ, Sidekiq or Celery, add retries, delayed jobs and priorities, and tune Redis eviction and persistence for queues.
days.deliverable: Job queue setup with tuning notes
checks: Delayed job runs at the scheduled time
No job data evicted under memory pressure

days.topic: Search and Query with the Redis Query Engine
subtopics: When to use a dedicated search engine
days.lab_task: Index products stored as hashes, run text search with tag and price filters, add autocomplete and aggregations by category and compare with a database query.
checks: Results match text, tag and price filters
Suggestions returned as the user types
objectives: Know when to use a search engine

days.lab_task: Store orders as JSON documents, update nested fields and arrays with JSONPath, index them for search and compare memory and speed with hashes.
checks: Nested field updated without rewriting the document
Indexed search finds orders by customer and status
Memory and speed compared with hashes

subtopics: Vector search compared with dedicated databases
tools: Redis Query Engine vectors or vector sets
days.lab_task: Store product embeddings, run KNN search with category filters, add a semantic cache for an AI assistant and measure recall and latency.
checks: Similar products found without shared keywords
Hybrid query respects the category filter
Similar questions served from the semantic cache

days.topic: Time Series and Probabilistic Data Structures
days.lab_task: Store sensor readings with retention and downsampling, count unique visitors with HyperLogLog, block repeat signups with a Bloom filter and track top products with Top-K.
checks: Hourly averages computed from raw readings
HyperLogLog estimate within the stated error
Repeat emails detected with no false negatives

days.topic: Performance Tuning: Pipelining, Latency and Big Keys
subtopics: Transparent huge pages and system settings
days.lab_task: Benchmark a workload, add pipelining, find and split big keys, fix system settings that cause latency spikes and record before and after results.
checks: Latency spikes from big keys gone

days.topic: Persistence and Backup Strategy in Production
days.lab_task: Design persistence and backups for cache, session and queue workloads, automate snapshot backups to object storage and run a timed restore drill.
days.deliverable: Backup strategy and restore drill report
checks: Snapshots copied to object storage on schedule
Restore completes within the target time
Each workload has fitting persistence settings

subtopics: When to use a managed service instead
days.lab_task: Deploy a highly available Redis on Kubernetes with an operator, persistent volumes, TLS and network policies, fail a pod and upgrade the version.
checks: Version upgraded with no data loss
Only the app namespace can connect

days.topic: Managed Redis: ElastiCache, Azure Managed Redis and Redis Cloud
subtopics: Scaling and resharding in managed services
days.lab_task: Deploy a cluster-mode managed Redis, connect through private networking with TLS, scale it, trigger a failover, restore a backup and estimate monthly cost.
days.deliverable: Managed Redis deployment and cost estimate
checks: Multi-AZ failover completes with clients reconnecting
Cluster scaled with no client errors
Monthly cost estimated for the workload
objectives: Scale and fail over in the cloud

subtopics: The Valkey fork and its governance
days.lab_task: Run the course project against Redis and Valkey, list compatibility differences, review licence terms with a checklist and recommend an engine for a company.
checks: Project works on both or differences listed
Licence obligations summarised for the company
Recommendation covers features, licence and support

days.lab_task: Audit a production-like Redis setup against a hardening checklist, fix network, ACL, TLS and file permission issues and document the remaining risks.
checks: Redis reachable only from app hosts
Each app limited to its own keys and commands
Persistence files readable only by Redis

subtopics: Alerting on memory, latency and replication
days.lab_task: Export Redis metrics to Prometheus, build a Grafana dashboard, add alerts for memory, latency and replication lag, and link each alert to a runbook.
checks: Memory, latency, hit rate and replication shown
Memory alert fires near the limit
Every alert links to a runbook

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Real-Time Order Tracking Backend
days.lab_task: Build a real-time order tracking back end with highly available Redis, streams for events, search for orders, client-side caching, locks, monitoring and backups, then present it.
checks: Order events flow to live views and search
Service keeps working through a Redis failover
Data structure and topology choices explained
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one system

advanced.summary: For senior engineers, DBAs and platform teams running Redis at scale. Covers Redis internals, large clusters and resharding, multi-region and active-active replication, capacity and memory engineering, latency and tail latency, disaster recovery, data modelling for very high throughput, Redis as a primary database, real-time analytics, Redis for AI applications, security and compliance, fleet automation, migrations between versions, Valkey and managed services, modules and functions, cost, chaos testing, observability at scale, Redis in microservices and incident troubleshooting.
prerequisites: Several years running Redis in production
Strong Linux, networking and distributed systems knowledge
Has operated Redis Cluster or Sentinel
outcomes: Design large, multi-region and highly available Redis estates
Engineer memory, latency, cost and reliability
Lead migrations and incident response for Redis

days.topic: Redis Internals: Event Loop, Data Encodings and Memory Allocator
subtopics: The event loop and I/O threads
Internal encodings: listpack, intset, skiplist and hashtable
days.lab_task: Show encodings changing as data grows, tune thresholds for a workload, measure fragmentation and active defragmentation, and explain I/O threading from the source.
checks: Encoding changes recorded at the thresholds
Memory reduced for the workload after tuning
Fragmentation ratio reduced by active defrag

days.topic: Cluster Architecture at Scale: Resharding and Multi-Shard Operations
days.lab_task: Design a 30-shard cluster for a growing workload, reshard online under load, measure client impact during topology changes and redesign keys that cause cross-slot errors.
checks: Resharding completes with error rates within target

subtopics: Active-active with conflict-free replicated data types
tools: Redis Enterprise or Redis Cloud active-active
days.lab_task: Design a two-region session and counter store, compare active-passive and active-active, show how concurrent increments and writes resolve and test regional failover.
checks: Traffic moves to the other region within target

subtopics: Forecasting key counts and value sizes
Memory overhead per key and type
days.lab_task: Build a capacity model for a two-year forecast, measure per-key overhead and fork memory, cut memory with data structure and compression choices and size the shards.
days.deliverable: Capacity model and memory savings report
checks: Memory and shards forecast for two years
Copy-on-write overhead measured during a snapshot
Memory reduced with no feature loss

subtopics: Latency sources: network, commands, persistence and system
Tail latency and why it matters
days.lab_task: Measure p99 and p999 latency for a workload, remove spikes from forks, scripts and system settings, tune client timeouts and meet a latency budget.

subtopics: Backups and replicas as recovery tools
days.lab_task: Define recovery objectives for cache, session and queue workloads, run drills for primary loss, region loss and accidental FLUSHALL, and update runbooks.

days.topic: Designing Data Models for Very High Throughput
days.lab_task: Design data models for a social feed and a flash sale handling a million operations per second, avoid hot keys, load test the designs and refine them.
days.deliverable: Data model designs with load results
checks: Design sustains the target throughput in tests

days.topic: Redis as a Primary Database: Trade-offs and Durability
subtopics: When Redis can be the system of record
days.lab_task: Assess a product that wants Redis as its main database, test durability with WAITAOF and replication, model indexes and write a recommendation.
checks: Acknowledged writes survive a crash under the chosen settings
Recommendation covers durability, cost and risk
objectives: Judge Redis as a primary store

days.topic: Real-Time Analytics with Streams and Sorted Sets
subtopics: Sorted sets for rankings over time
days.lab_task: Build a real-time analytics pipeline for a live event with streams, windowed counters, trending rankings and unique counts, feeding a live dashboard.
checks: Unique viewers estimated within error bounds
Pipeline keeps up with the event rate

days.topic: Redis for AI Applications: Semantic Caching and Agent Memory
days.lab_task: Add retrieval, a semantic cache and agent memory on Redis to an AI assistant, measure cache hit quality and calculate the cost saved.
days.deliverable: AI features on Redis with evaluation
checks: Cached answers returned only for truly similar questions
LLM cost saved by caching calculated

subtopics: Identity and access across many apps
Encryption in transit and at rest
days.lab_task: Design security for a regulated Redis estate with per-app identities, encryption, key management, audit logs and data classification rules, and run a review.
checks: Sensitive data types mapped to allowed stores

days.lab_task: Manage a fleet of Redis instances as code, provision a new instance for a team through self-service, roll an upgrade across the fleet and report fleet health.
checks: Team gets a configured instance from a request

days.topic: Migrating Between Redis Versions, Valkey and Managed Services
subtopics: Moving to or from managed services
days.lab_task: Migrate a live workload from self-managed Redis to a managed Valkey or Redis service with replication-based migration, test compatibility, cut over and keep a rollback path.
checks: Application tests pass on the target
Cutover completes within the agreed downtime

days.topic: Extending Redis with Modules and Functions
subtopics: Writing a simple module in C or Rust
days.lab_task: Move business logic into a versioned Redis Function library, write a small module that adds a custom command, test both and assess the operational risk.
checks: Custom command works after loading the module
Operational risks and support limits documented

subtopics: Cost per team and per feature
days.lab_task: Analyse a month of Redis costs, find oversized and idle instances, cut memory use, apply reserved pricing and report cost per team.
checks: Monthly cost reduced with no SLO breach

days.lab_task: Run chaos experiments on a Redis cluster with partitions, node kills and memory pressure while traffic runs, record client behaviour and fix weaknesses.
checks: Client behaviour during the partition recorded

days.topic: Observability at Scale for Redis Fleets
subtopics: Hot key and big key detection at scale
days.lab_task: Build fleet dashboards with per-app usage and command stats, detect hot and big keys across instances, correlate Redis latency with app traces and tune alerts.
checks: Hot keys found across the fleet
Slow app requests linked to Redis latency
Alert noise reduced while catching real issues

subtopics: Shared Redis compared with Redis per service
days.lab_task: Review a microservices estate's use of Redis, split a shared instance by service, move cross-service events to streams and isolate failures.
checks: One service's Redis issue no longer affects others

days.lab_task: Work through four incidents: memory exhaustion, a blocking command, a failover loop and a connection storm, restore service and write one post-incident review.
days.deliverable: Incident notes and a post-incident review
checks: All four incidents mitigated within their time limits
Review lists causes and follow-up actions

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Global Low-Latency Data Layer
days.lab_task: Design and build a global low-latency data layer for sessions, caching, rate limits and real-time features with multi-region replication, capacity and cost models, DR drills and fleet automation, then defend it to a review panel.
days.deliverable: Architecture, models, drill reports and defence
checks: p99 latency within target in each region
Review panel questions answered with evidence
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one platform
